title.en: I know that you know that I know

hint.zh: 诸葛亮赌的是司马懿「多想一层」
hint.en: Zhuge Liang bets that Sima Yi will think one level too far

hint.zh: 曹操多想了一层，正好踩进诸葛亮多想两层挖的坑
hint.en: Cao Cao thinks one level further, straight into a trap dug two levels deep

title.zh: 福尔摩斯在坎特伯雷下车

hint.zh: 冯·诺依曼拿它当教材：最优解是掷骰子
hint.en: Von Neumann used it as a textbook case: the best answer is to roll dice

title.en: The schoolboy who guessed odd or even

hint.zh: 文学里最早的「你想到第几层」
hint.en: The earliest “how many levels deep do you think” in literature

title.en: A battle of wits over two cups

hint.zh: 「所以我绝不能喝你面前那杯」——可以一直推下去
hint.en: “So I clearly cannot choose the wine in front of you” — and so on without end

hint.zh: 她说的是「不」，他听到的是「再求一次」
hint.en: She says no; he hears “ask again”

hint.zh: 私心越大，话越不值钱
hint.en: The larger the bias, the less the words are worth

title.en: Zou Ji asks who is fairer

hint.zh: 夸你的人各有各的理由，唯独不是因为你美
hint.en: Everyone who praises you has a reason, and it is never your looks

hint.zh: 两个人都为对方多想了一层，于是恰好错开
hint.en: Each thinks one level further for the other, and so they miss

hint.zh: 不是选你觉得最美的，是选大家觉得大家会选的
hint.en: Pick not the prettiest, but what everyone thinks everyone will pick

hint.zh: 两个互相提防的人，各写一字，摊开手一模一样
hint.en: Two wary allies each write one word; they open their hands to the same one

hint.zh: 没法商量时，两个人会不约而同想到同一个地方
hint.en: With no way to confer, two people still think of the same place

hint.zh: 通篇都是好话，读完却知道这人不行
hint.en: Nothing but praise, and yet you finish it knowing he will not do

hint.zh: 猜得太准，是要掉脑袋的
hint.en: Guess too well and it costs you your head

hint.zh: 没说出口的那半句，是听的人自己推出来的
hint.en: The half left unsaid is worked out by the listener

hint.zh: 话说得越含糊，越安全
hint.en: The vaguer the words, the safer

hint.zh: 读本 · 满座都在打暗号，只有该看懂的那个人不接
hint.en: Reader · The whole table is trading signals; the one man meant to read them will not

hint.zh: 读本 · 骂的是丫头，说给宝玉听，宝钗也听得懂
hint.en: Reader · She scolds the maid, means it for Baoyu, and Baochai understands too

hint.zh: 读本 · 让对方以为是他自己偷到的，他才会深信不疑
hint.en: Reader · Let him think he stole it himself, and he will never doubt it

hint.zh: 读本 · 先让你相信「我看得出你有病」，再让你自己走瘸
hint.en: Reader · First you believe he can see you are ill; then you limp on your own

title.zh: 「大臣，这是个很有勇气的决定」

hint.zh: 读本 · 公务员的夸奖要查字典：勇气 = 丢选票
hint.en: Reader · A civil servant's praise needs a dictionary: courageous means losing the election

title.zh: 他们不知道我们知道他们知道
title.en: They don't know that we know they know

hint.zh: 读本 · 情景喜剧史上嵌套最深的一句台词
hint.en: Reader · The most deeply nested line in sitcom history

title.en: The debate on the bridge over the Hao

hint.zh: 读本 · 两千三百年前，就有人追问「你怎么知道我不知道」
hint.en: Reader · 2,300 years ago someone already asked: how do you know that I don't know?

hint.zh: 读本 · 确认了一万次，仍然不敢动手
hint.en: Reader · Ten thousand confirmations, and still neither dares to move

hint.zh: 读本 · 一句人人早就知道的话，为什么还能改变一切
hint.en: Reader · Why a sentence everyone already knew can still change everything

summary.zh: 两个人互相猜：我知道你知道我知道。25 个有出处的案例（空城计、福尔摩斯与莫里亚蒂、爱伦·坡的猜单双……）。其中 16 个带博弈（记录里有 game 字段），能按“双方各想几层”算出结果；另外 9 个是读本，只有分层的文字讲解。先在 cases 里找案例的编号，再用 compute 跑。
summary.en: Two people guessing each other: I know that you know that I know. 25 sourced cases (the Empty Fort, Holmes and Moriarty, Poe's odd-or-even…). 16 of them carry a game (the record has a `game` field) and can be computed for "how many levels each side reasons"; the other 9 are readers with a level-by-level prose account only. Find a case id in `cases`, then run `compute`.

description.zh: 每个案例：故事梗概、两个人物、出处、原作里两人各想到第几层（canonical）；可运行的案例还有博弈的结构（game：状态、话、行动、字面相容度、双方收益），读本则有分层讲解（layers）。_id 就是 compute 要的 case_id，_group 是类别（bluff、cheap_talk、common_knowledge、coordination、implicature）。没有 game 字段的案例不能交给 compute。
description.en: Each case: the story, the two characters, the source and how many levels each reasons in the original (`canonical`); a runnable case also has the structure of the game (`game`: states, messages, actions, literal fit, both payoffs), and a reader has a level-by-level account (`layers`). `_id` is the case_id that `compute` takes and `_group` the category (bluff, cheap_talk, common_knowledge, coordination, implicature). A case without a `game` field cannot be passed to `compute`.

datasets.licence: MIT (summaries written for this repository; quoted works keep their own copyright)

provenance.zh: 梗概和博弈的数值（先验、收益、字面相容度）是为这个仓库写的，是对故事的一种建模，不是原作里的数。source 字段写明作品、作者、位置、引文和网址；verified 为 true 的 22 个是对着原文核对过回目和引文的，其余 3 个（schelling_nyc、muddy_children、scalar_some）没有核对。标题和看点有英文（title_en、hook_en），其余文字只有中文。
provenance.en: The summaries and the numbers of each game (priors, payoffs, literal fit) were written for this repository; they are one way of modelling the story, not figures from the original. `source` gives the work, author, locator, quotation and URL; the 22 cases with `verified: true` had chapter and quotation checked against the original, and the other 3 (schelling_nyc, muddy_children, scalar_some) were not checked. Title and hook also exist in English (`title_en`, `hook_en`); everything else is Chinese only.

description.zh: 给定案例和双方各想几层，算出每个人脑中每一层怎么想、最后各自怎么选、结果如何。第 0 层照字面或凭直觉，第 d 层针对对方的第 d-1 层做软最优回应。还可以做反事实：换实情、调理性度、替某一方选、把某一层的结论钉成别的、加一句自己的话。确定性，不调用模型。只有文字讲解的读本会返回 400。
description.en: Given a case and how many levels each side reasons, compute what each thinks at every level, what each finally chooses and the outcome. Level 0 reads literally or goes by gut; level d soft-best-responds to the other side's level d-1. Counterfactuals are available: change the true state, tune rationality, choose for one side, pin a level's conclusion to something else, add a message of your own. Deterministic; no model is called. A prose-only reader returns 400.

case_id.description: cases 数据集里的 _id，要是带 game 字段的案例，例如 kongchengji / the _id from the `cases` dataset; must be a case with a `game` field, e.g. kongchengji

depth_a.description: a（说话的一方 / 甲）想几层；不给就用原作里的 / levels a (the speaker, or player A) reasons; the original story's when omitted

depth_b.description: b（听的一方 / 乙）想几层；不给就用原作里的 / levels b (the listener, or player B) reasons; the original story's when omitted

lam_a.description: a 的理性度：0 是乱选，越大越接近最优回应；不给就用案例自带的（0.5–3） / a's rationality: 0 is uniform random, higher is closer to best response; the case's own value (0.5–3) when omitted

lam_b.description: b 的理性度 / b's rationality

true_state.description: 只用于信号博弈：真实的状态是 game.states 里的第几个（从 0 数） / signaling games only: index into game.states of the true state (from 0)

bias.description: 只用于二次收益的案例（game.quadratic 不为空，目前是 crawford_sobel）：说话者的私心有多大 / quadratic-payoff cases only (game.quadratic is set; currently crawford_sobel): the size of the speaker's bias

forced_a.description: 替 a 选：信号博弈里是 game.messages 的下标，同时博弈里是 game.actions_a 的下标。返回里的 played.a 说这个选择相当于想了几层 / choose for a: an index into game.messages (signaling) or game.actions_a (simultaneous). `played.a` in the reply says how many levels of thought the choice equals

forced_b.description: 替 b 选：game.actions（信号博弈）或 game.actions_b（同时博弈）的下标 / choose for b: an index into game.actions (signaling) or game.actions_b (simultaneous)

pins.description: 把某一层的结论钉死，外层据此重算：{谁脑中的塔 a|b: {层号: {行: 列}}}。行和列是那一层 rows、cols 的下标（见返回的 towers）；同时博弈只有第 0 行。比塔还深的层会被忽略 / pin a level's conclusion and let the outer levels recompute: {whose tower, a|b: {level: {row: column}}}. Row and column index that level's `rows` and `cols` (see `towers` in the reply); a simultaneous game has row 0 only. Levels deeper than the tower are ignored

extra_messages.description: 只用于信号博弈：给说话者多加几句可说的话，排在 game.messages 后面 / signaling games only: extra messages the speaker may use, appended to game.messages

cost.description: 说这句话的代价，从说话者的收益里扣；缺省 0 / cost of saying it, subtracted from the speaker's payoff; 0 when omitted

literal.description: 字面上这句话与每个状态有多相容，每个状态一个数，不能全是 0 / how well the message literally fits each state, one number per state, not all 0

ladder_depth.description: 返回里 analysis 的阶梯算到几层，缺省 12 / how many levels the `analysis` ladder in the reply covers; 12 when omitted

output.zh: 一个对象：case（案例的说明）、game（实际用的博弈）、depth 和 lam（实际用的层数和理性度）、towers.a / towers.b（每个人脑中从第 0 层到最高层：role、policy[行][列]、rows、cols、choice、belief、一句中文结论 line）、outcome（各自的选择、收益，信号博弈还有听者猜对没有）、analysis（两人同步加深时每层的结论和指标，走向是 converged、cycle 还是 unsettled）、equilibrium（无限层的极限）、canonical_match（与原作是否一致）、played（用了 forced 时，这个选择相当于几层）。
output.en: An object: `case` (the case description), `game` (the game actually used), `depth` and `lam` (the depths and rationalities actually used), `towers.a` / `towers.b` (each person's tower from level 0 to the top: role, policy[row][column], rows, cols, choice, belief and a one-line conclusion `line` in Chinese), `outcome` (both choices and payoffs; for signaling games also whether the listener guessed right), `analysis` (conclusions and metrics per level as both deepen together, with a verdict of converged, cycle or unsettled), `equilibrium` (the infinite-depth limit), `canonical_match` (whether it agrees with the original) and `played` (with a forced choice, the depth it is equivalent to).
